title: Jouko Vyörykkä, PhD (R&D Fellow, Dow Construction Chemicals) — 'A strongly recommended read, and frankly a must-read for startup founders'
summary: Jouko Vyörykkä — R&D Fellow at Dow Construction Chemicals — publishes a LinkedIn endorsement framing Incorruptible as required reading for anyone still holding control over their company's governance and mission.
blockquote: A strongly recommended read, and frankly a must-read for startup founders, executives, or anyone who still has control over their company's governance and mission.
